task.title: Processing an adoption application
task.shortdesc: Review an application, approve or decline it, and finalize the adoption.

step.cmd: Click Adoptions and open an application with status New.
Click Start review so teammates know you're working on it.

substep.cmd: Call at least one reference and record the outcome.
If the adopter rents, confirm landlord approval.
Check the adopter's history for previous returns or do-not-adopt flags.

choices.choice: Approve: the animal moves to Adoption pending.
Decline: choose a reason. The adopter receives your shelter's decline email.

step.cmd: When the adopter arrives, click Finalize, collect the signature and fee, and print the go-home packet.

result.p: The animal's status changes to Adopted, its listing is removed, and a follow-up survey is scheduled for 2 weeks later.
